title: Llama 3 Model Documentation and Authorship
summary: This community centers on the 2024 technical paper 'The Llama 3 Herd of Models,' which documents the development and capabilities of the Llama 3 large language models. The cluster specifically highlights the authorship contributions of Abhimanyu Dubey and Abhinav Jauhri to this foundational work. The paper is identified as a key resource in the field of artificial intelligence, published on arXiv.
key_findings: The paper 'The Llama 3 Herd of Models' was published in 2024 on arXiv with the identifier 2407.21783.
Abhimanyu Dubey is identified as a primary author of the Llama 3 model documentation.
Abhinav Jauhri is also listed as an author of the Llama 3 model documentation.
The paper is categorized under the subject area of Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI).
The document serves as a reference for the Llama 3 models within the broader context of recent AI literature.
